title: UI 请求解析应跨 Pattern、Composition、Concrete Surface、Production Realization 与视觉证据层返回结果
summary: 单独检索 Grammar Pattern 只能回答‘这种界面机制叫什么’；单独检索产品 Surface 只能回答‘哪里已经有这个具体界面’。Foundry 应将两者双向连接，再附上组合 Recipe、真实项目实现、Reference Demo/Visual Baseline 和缺失证据，使自然语言请求直接落到可复用语义与可核验具体实现。
principles: Natural-language resolution may start from reusable grammar or a concrete product surface.
Strong concrete-surface matches can lift explicitly linked Patterns; this is provenance-backed enrichment, not semantic guessing.
Matched Patterns expand to source-owned product Surfaces through explicit Pattern links.
Production Realization and Showcase evidence are returned as separate layers.
Evidence gaps remain first-class output, especially missing production screenshots/recordings.
The resolver does not promote Pattern maturity or rewrite source-owned inventories.
